elements.reason: the RunsScreen ledger's: one page at every width

elements.el: The search stays visible and every other filter folds behind one Filters button
elements.reason: the browser script folds the bar (filterbar--collapsible, which bundle.css draws on a phone) and shows the toggle, which is drawn hidden; without the script every filter shows and the toggle stays hidden

elements.el: Filters (1): the button counts the folded filters
elements.reason: every applied filter but the search, which stays in view

elements.el: The summary strip shows the four counts that matter
elements.reason: refused, failed, awaiting input and cancelled: a phone leaves out the completed count; the card's four are the total, failed, refused and awaiting input, and the total is the All chip's

elements.el: Stacked rows: the job id and when it ended on top
elements.reason: the end time at the row's right with no label: its column's phone label is "", so the kit writes no data-l

elements.el: Stacked rows: the outcome badge and reason sentence across the full width
elements.reason: bundle.css spans a wide cell across a stacked row; the sentence takes the row's width, and the cell carries no label, as the card stacks it

elements.el: Stacked rows: the target and project tag
elements.reason: the project tag rides in the target's cell, so the two are one line, with no label, as the card stacks it

elements.el: Stacked rows: the host and the cost
elements.reason: the two cells the card labels, and the only two a stacked run's row labels

an id is a box of its own that moves to the next line whole; only one wider than the row (a cron run's repeat:<trigger>:<slot>) breaks, rather than push the page sideways (runs-css.mjs); on a desktop the runs page draws a job id as a box of its own, as wide as the id and at most 22 characters of the code face (runs-css.mjs RUNS_TABLE.idMaxCh), inside which a longer id breaks, at a hyphen first, since one scheduler's repeat:<trigger>:<slot> made the Job column 282 px wide for every row; 22 and not the card's 12, which broke a forge delivery's id (gh- and a GUID, 39 to 42 characters) into four or five lines where 22 hold it in two

elements.el: Flow, venue, model, tokens and job cap are on the run page
elements.reason: left off a phone, and off a desktop narrower than the RunsScreen card's own 1,440 px (runs-css.mjs RUNS_TABLE.allMin), the kit marking each one's head as it marks its cells

elements.el: The same data as the desktop page
elements.reason: one page and one read at every width; a phone is the same markup under the phone's rules

elements.el: The phone layout is CSS only (tbl--stack, data-l labels, filterbar--collapsible)
elements.reason: bundle.css draws tbl--stack, the data-l labels and the fold, and runs-css.mjs orders the stacked cells; the kit writes a data-l only where a column has a phone label (the host and the cost here); the fold's class is the browser script's, so the toggle is the one part that needs it
